architecture.name: TransferService
architecture.description: Handles bank account transfers, transfer validation, transaction execution, and transfer status.

architecture.name: SecurityService
architecture.description: Provides authentication, authorization, account protection, access control, and security checks for banking operations.

architecture.name: NotificationService
architecture.description: Sends transaction alerts and security notifications to customers.

database.name: Customer
database.description: Stores customer profile, account identity, and contact information.

database.name: BankAccount
database.description: Stores bank account details including account owner, account number, account status, and current balance.

database.name: Transaction
database.description: Stores banking transaction records including transfer amount, source account, destination account, timestamp, and status.

database.name: SecurityAudit
database.description: Stores security audit events including login attempts, suspicious access, and sensitive banking activities.

api.name: POST /transfers
api.description: Creates and executes a transfer between eligible bank accounts.

api.name: GET /accounts/{id}/balance
api.description: Returns the current account balance to an authenticated and authorized customer.

api.name: POST /auth/login
api.description: Authenticates customers using valid banking credentials before access to protected services.

components.name: MoneyTransferComponent
components.description: Provides application and user-facing functionality for transferring money between bank accounts.

components.name: AccountBalanceComponent
components.description: Provides functionality for viewing bank account balance information.

components.name: SecurityComponent
components.description: Implements authentication, authorization, access control, and protection of banking information.

components.name: TransactionAlertComponent
components.description: Generates and sends alerts to customers after important banking transactions.
